_why: HEART coverage ratchet — it may only RISE. A fall means a surface this console used to watch is no longer watched, which in a green run reads exactly like clean. A surface is watched only where a watcher's CODE names it whole (REG-1555): the floor of 17 blessed on 2026-09-29 counted 13 names that stood only in comments, docstrings or inside a longer id, and was lowered to the measured count on 2026-09-30 for that reason.
